mission.title: The Misinformation Age
mission.description: Recover the dead inventor's schematic for the prototype gun.

npc.say: Don't get in trouble with that, sugar.
Leave me be. I don't have time for you now...
Just give that money to Rarahu. That should smooth things over.
I had Rarahu locked up the inventor's office. She still has some papers the Merovingian wants.
Flood says we'll get a replacement for this station, I just don't know when.

phase.briefing:
The traitorous inventor that you so graciously eliminated for us in your last assignment managed to hide a schematic from us. He designed blueprints for every invention he created and I am certain his last prototype was no exception. Now that he's gone, what was his is ours; and you'll be the arm of this particular action.
Go to his office and recover the schematic for the prototype gun. If anyone tries to take the schematic from you, simply kill them.

enter.say:
Everyone on-site is with the Merovingian, so don't expect any opposition.
Just stick to your goals and this will be over in a heartbeat.

done.say: It's not in there. Keep looking.
Hmm... Perhaps Fissure has a printout of the schematic. Ask nice and maybe he'll cough it up.

talk.say: The schematic? What? For the Merovingian? Uh, sure. You can have it. Just don't tell anyone I was in here, okay?

Let me guess: you want the key to the inventor's office, don't you? Well, I'm not some nut that cracks for everyone -- you must do me a favor first.
Find Efremiana and tell him that he's been "cut off." In return, I'll do you a favor and give you the key to the inventor's office. Does that deal sound sweet enough for you?

done.say: Just give that money to Rarahu. That should smooth things over.
I knew that would knock some sense into him! Efremiana can't go without gettin' into my parties... Then again, who can? Right, sugar? Oh, wait... Silly me, you want the key! Yes, you may take it.
Don't get in trouble with that, sugar.

near.say: That's the inventor's old office. Search the place for the schematic.
Oh, crap! What are you doing here?! I know I'm not supposed to be in here, but I just had to take a look around...

phase.briefing: This might be your shortest assignment yet. Meet with Cert and present him the schematic.

enter.say: That's the place. Cert is inside.

talk.say: The schematic, do you have it?
Don't stand there gawking like you've never seen an impatient man before. Give me the schematic.

done.say: I have never been so furious at another Exile in my entire existence. Fissure -- and whoever he is in league with -- will bleed for feeding us misinformation!
Crap! This is not cool. Flood is livid.
What the hell is this? Is this some sort of sick joke? This is an obvious fake! Don't you see the crayon here?! This is terrible! Find whoever gave this forgery to you and destroy them!

phase.briefing: I've tracked Fissure to this address. That fool will suffer for deceiving us!

enter.say:
I can't believe he actually gave you a forged schematic... What a goon!
No matter. That's where Fissure is hiding. Do the dirty deed.

done.say: Roger that. That's a confirmed kill. Search Fissure's body for the schematic.
Do you see any crayon or markers on that schematic? No? Good. That's the real deal. Upload it through a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the real Schematic at a hardline

done.say: That's the last of the hostiles. Nice work, {player}.

mission.finish: At last, the schematic is in our hands. You came through in a crisis, {player}. You affirm your dedication to the Merovingian through your actions. Individuals such as Fissure are a pox on the Exiles and at times they must be removed -- permanently. In your case, the Frenchman is pleased with your performance. Until we speak again...
